backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining trade analysis types, session storage, and helper functions like metal PnL calculation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking heatmap animation and interval changes to specific frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component managing analysis state, error handling, tab navigation, and rendering either upload or results views.
Displays analysis results with asset filtering, summary cards, charts, fee overview, and CSV export.
frontend/src/components/AssetSelector.ts: Asset filtering UI with search, grouped asset lists for metals/stablecoins/cryptos, and category‑based styling.
frontend/src/components/ChartsSection.ts: Builds multiple Recharts-based visualizations for PnL, trade direction, long/short distribution, liquidation status, and asset-level PnL. Aggregates position metrics, computes chart data, and assigns dynamic coloring.
frontend/src/components/FeeOverview.tsx: Analyzes trading fees and structures them by asset, direction, category, and efficiency. Renders visualizations and recommendations using fee‑alpha utilities and Recharts.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with branding, attribution, and version text.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the app header with icon, title, and subtitle in a sticky top bar.
frontend/src/components/orderbook/Orderb: Canvas-based heatmap renderer for orderbook data that interpolates updates smoothly and draws bid/ask visuals according to rendering mode.
frontend/src/components/OrderbookHeatmap: Provides an interactive UI for viewing live Hyperliquid orderbook heatmaps with symbol, depth, interval, and rendering mode controls. Fetches and visualizes orderbook data with pause and refresh options.
frontend/src/components/PositionsTable.t: Displays a sortable, collapsible table of trade positions grouped by asset type, including fee‑alpha sorting, leverage color cues, and detailed row expansion.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCards.tsx: Shows summary metrics like total positions, liquidation rate, PnL, and asset‑type PnL with optional asset filtering. Uses visual indicators and aggregated position stats.
frontend/src/components/UploadSection.ts: UI component that handles CSV upload with drag-and-drop, validates file content, parses data, and triggers analysis callbacks with error handling and toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useHyperliquidOrderbo: Hook that fetches Hyperliquid orderbook data via direct API or backend fallback, parses levels, and provides polling with error and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, state transitions, and access to the user’s authenticated identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and storing analysis sessions, assembling asset statistics, and interacting with the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying global border and background/text styles.
frontend/src/lib/csvExporter.ts: Builds and downloads a CSV export of analyzed trade data, including fee alpha calculations and proper CSV escaping.
frontend/src/lib/csvParser.ts: Parses CSV trade data with German‑to‑English column mappings, header detection, and type inference for fields like symbols and directions.
frontend/src/lib/feeAlpha.ts: Computes fee‑efficiency metrics such as fee alpha scores and labels, with helpers for formatting and aggregating positions by asset or direction.
frontend/src/lib/hyperliquidMarkets.ts: Provides a fixed list of supported Hyperliquid markets with utilities to validate, sanitize, and select a default symbol.
frontend/src/lib/hyperliquidOrderbook.ts: Parses raw Hyperliquid orderbook data into numeric bids/asks, computes mid‑price, and validates the resulting structure.
frontend/src/lib/orderbookHeatmapRenderi: Contains normalization, interpolation, color mapping, and drawing utilities for rendering orderbook heatmap and depth visuals.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides UI helpers for class merging, currency formatting, status/risk labeling, asset category detection, and filtering/sorting of trade positions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme tokens, colors, container settings, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project metadata capturing features, architecture notes, issues, and current build state for the Hyperliquid Trade Analyzer.
